assay: bulk polyA RNA-seq, soleus muscle, male mice (S2.5.p1, S3.3.p1)

genotype: TRa1 HSACre (L400R dominant-negative, 'TRa1 KO' in GEO)

sample_inclusion: WT and TRa-HSACre SOL, vehicle n=5-6/4-6, T3 n=5-6/7 (FIG3); GEO has 22 samples (11 WT/11 KO; 9 vehicle/13 T3)
primary_estimand: Effect of muscle TRa1 loss-of-function (genotype) on the soleus transcriptome under vehicle, and the T3 response by genotype (S3.3.p1). No exercise factor in the RNA-seq.
planned_contrasts: KO vs WT, vehicle (S3.3.p1/FIG3A; paper: 788 DEGs)
WT-T3 vs KO-T3 (FIG3B/C; GO enrichment, no DEG count)
exercise_component: Treadmill exhaustion and 6-week voluntary wheel running were phenotyping endpoints only (S2.4, S3.1.p1, FIG1E/F); no exercised samples were sequenced.

paper_threshold.source_locator: S2.11.p1 (FDR-adjusted P; cutoff assumed 0.05 from P < .05 significance rule)

paper_method: edgeR QL, ~0 + group (group = genotype x treatment), contrasts per edgeR manual (S2.6.p1)
